name: handoff
description: /handoff writes a six section handoff note (goal, status, what changed, next steps, gotchas, how to verify) from the live session and git facts, saves it under ~/.claude/handoffs/<project>, copies it and shows it in a pane. /handoff resume fills the prompt with the newest note so a fresh session can continue from it.

dir.title: Notes folder
dir.description: Base folder for the notes. Each project gets its own subfolder. A path starting with ~/ is under your home folder, a relative path is under the project root.

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.description: Put each new note on the clipboard.
